introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.p2: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of our website, applications, event management tools, ticketing services, and related features.
introduction.p3: G-ventZ provides a platform that enables users to create, publish, discover, manage, and promote events, register attendees, and sell tickets.
introduction.p4: By creating an account or using our services, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, you must discontinue using the platform.

eligibilityAndAccounts.title: Eligibility and Accounts
eligibilityAndAccounts.p1: You must have the legal capacity to enter into a binding agreement to use our services.
eligibilityAndAccounts.b1: Provide accurate and complete registration information.
eligibilityAndAccounts.b3: Maintain accurate information about your events.
eligibilityAndAccounts.b4: Notify us promptly of unauthorized access to your account.
eligibilityAndAccounts.b5: Accept responsibility for activities conducted through your account, subject to applicable law.
eligibilityAndAccounts.a1: We reserve the right to restrict or suspend accounts that violate these Terms.

eventOrganizers.title: Event Organizers
eventOrganizers.p1: Event organizers are responsible for the events they publish and manage through our platform.
eventOrganizers.b1: Provide accurate event descriptions, dates, locations, schedules, and ticket prices.
eventOrganizers.b2: Obtain all permits, licenses, and authorizations required for their events.
eventOrganizers.b3: Ensure their events comply with applicable laws.
eventOrganizers.b4: Clearly disclose event-specific rules and refund conditions.
eventOrganizers.b5: Deliver the events and services advertised to attendees.
eventOrganizers.b6: Handle attendee inquiries, complaints, cancellations, and applicable refunds.
eventOrganizers.b7: Avoid misleading advertising, fraudulent ticket sales, and unauthorized use of intellectual property.
eventOrganizers.a1: Organizers must not use the platform to facilitate illegal activities, fraudulent transactions, or prohibited events.

attendeesAndTicketPurchases.title: Attendees and Ticket Purchases
attendeesAndTicketPurchases.p1: Attendees are responsible for reviewing event information before purchasing tickets.
attendeesAndTicketPurchases.p2: A ticket purchase creates a transaction between the attendee and the relevant event organizer, subject to the applicable payment arrangements and consumer protection laws.
attendeesAndTicketPurchases.p3: Tickets may be subject to event-specific restrictions, admission conditions, identification requirements, or transfer limitations.
attendeesAndTicketPurchases.p4: We do not guarantee admission where an attendee violates an event's published entry requirements.

platformFeesAndPayments.title: Platform Fees and Payments
platformFeesAndPayments.p1: Creating an account and publishing free events may be available without charge.
platformFeesAndPayments.p2: Paid ticket sales may attract platform fees, payment processing charges, subscription fees, or other clearly disclosed charges.
platformFeesAndPayments.p3: Applicable fees will be presented before the relevant transaction is completed.
platformFeesAndPayments.p4: Payment processing may be provided by third-party payment service providers. Their terms and policies may also apply.
platformFeesAndPayments.p5: Organizers are responsible for ensuring their payment and payout information is accurate and for complying with applicable tax and reporting obligations.
platformFeesAndPayments.p6: We may update our pricing with reasonable notice. Changes will not retroactively alter fees already charged on completed transactions.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.p1: Ticket proceeds will be paid to eligible organizers according to the applicable payout schedule and payment provider requirements.
payouts.p2: Payouts may be delayed where additional verification is required, a transaction is disputed, fraud is suspected, a refund is pending, or applicable law requires a restriction.
payouts.p3: We may maintain reasonable reserves where permitted by law and our payment processing agreements.
payouts.p4: We will not intentionally withhold funds without a legitimate contractual, legal, security, or payment-processing reason.

cancellationsAndRefunds.title: Cancellations and Refunds
cancellationsAndRefunds.p1: Event organizers must clearly disclose their refund policy before attendees purchase tickets.
cancellationsAndRefunds.p2: Refund requests will be handled according to the event's published policy, these Terms, and applicable law.
cancellationsAndRefunds.p3: If an event is cancelled, the organizer must communicate the cancellation promptly and issue refunds where required by law or the applicable event policy.
cancellationsAndRefunds.p4: Refunds may take several business days to appear, depending on the payment provider and the attendee's financial institution.
cancellationsAndRefunds.p5: Platform fees and payment processing fees will be treated according to the applicable fee disclosure, payment provider rules, and legal requirements.
cancellationsAndRefunds.p6: Nothing in this section removes any mandatory refund or consumer rights available under applicable law.

prohibitedActivities.title: Prohibited Activities
prohibitedActivities.b2: Sell counterfeit, unauthorized, or invalid tickets.
prohibitedActivities.b3: Manipulate ticket sales or payment systems.
prohibitedActivities.b4: Circumvent platform fees or security controls.
prohibitedActivities.b6: Send unsolicited marketing communications in violation of applicable law.
prohibitedActivities.b7: Upload malicious software or attempt unauthorized access to our systems.
prohibitedActivities.b9: Use the platform for unlawful discrimination, harassment, fraud, or other prohibited conduct.
prohibitedActivities.a1: We may remove content, cancel listings, restrict features, or suspend accounts where reasonably necessary to enforce these Terms or comply with the law.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.p1: You retain ownership of the content you own and upload to the platform.
intellectualProperty.p2: By publishing event content, you grant G-ventZ a limited, non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to host, reproduce, display, and distribute that content as reasonably necessary to operate, promote, and provide the services you request.
intellectualProperty.p3: You represent that you have the rights and permissions necessary to upload and use your content.
intellectualProperty.p4: Our software, branding, interface, and original platform materials remain our property or the property of our licensors.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Our collection and use of personal information are governed by our Privacy Policy.
privacy.p2: Organizers must process attendee information lawfully and use it only for permitted event administration, communications, and other disclosed purposes.
privacy.p3: Organizers must obtain any consent required before using attendee information for unrelated marketing.

thirdPartyServices.title: Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.p1: Our platform may integrate with payment processors, analytics providers, email services, identity verification tools, and other third-party services.
thirdPartyServices.p2: We are not responsible for independent third-party services beyond the responsibilities imposed on us by applicable law or our agreements with those providers.
thirdPartyServices.p3: Your use of those services may be subject to additional terms.

serviceAvailability.title: Service Availability
serviceAvailability.p1: We aim to provide a reliable service but do not guarantee uninterrupted access.
serviceAvailability.p2: Maintenance, technical issues, security incidents, or circumstances beyond our reasonable control may temporarily affect availability.
serviceAvailability.p3: We will take reasonable steps to restore affected services.

limitationOfLiability.title: Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.p1: To the extent permitted by applicable law, G-ventZ is not responsible for losses arising solely from an organizer's failure to deliver an event, inaccurate event information supplied by an organizer, or disputes between organizers and attendees.
limitationOfLiability.p2: Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot legally be excluded, including applicable consumer rights and liability for fraud or intentional misconduct.
limitationOfLiability.p3: Any other limitation of liability will apply only to the extent permitted by applicable law.

accountSuspensionAndTermination.title: Account Suspension and Termination
accountSuspensionAndTermination.p1: You may stop using the platform at any time.
accountSuspensionAndTermination.p2: We may suspend or terminate access where you materially breach these Terms, engage in fraud, create a security risk, or where suspension is necessary to comply with law.
accountSuspensionAndTermination.p3: Where reasonably possible, we will explain the reason for suspension and provide an opportunity to resolve the issue.
accountSuspensionAndTermination.p4: Outstanding payment, refund, and legal obligations may survive termination.

changesToTheseTerms.title: Changes to These Terms
changesToTheseTerms.p1: We may update these Terms from time to time.
changesToTheseTerms.p2: Material changes will be communicated through the platform, by email, or through another appropriate method.
changesToTheseTerms.p3: The revised Terms will state their effective date.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.p1: These Terms are governed by the laws of Nigeria, subject to mandatory legal protections applicable to users.
governingLaw.p2: Any dispute will be handled by the competent courts or dispute resolution bodies determined under applicable law.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.p1: This Privacy Policy will explain how G-ventZ collects, uses and protects your personal information when you use our website, apps and ticketing services.

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: This Refund and Cancellation Policy explains how refund requests are handled for events published through G-ventZ.
overview.p2: Our platform provides tools for organizers to publish events, sell tickets, and manage registrations. Unless expressly stated otherwise, event organizers are responsible for delivering their events and administering event-specific refunds.
overview.p3: This policy is subject to applicable consumer protection laws.

eventSpecificRefundPolicies.title: Event-Specific Refund Policies
eventSpecificRefundPolicies.p1: Each organizer must establish a refund policy for their event.
eventSpecificRefundPolicies.p2: The applicable policy should be displayed before a ticket purchase and may specify:
eventSpecificRefundPolicies.b2: The deadline for requesting a refund.
eventSpecificRefundPolicies.b3: Whether cancellations are eligible for full or partial refunds.
eventSpecificRefundPolicies.b4: Whether tickets can be transferred to another person.
eventSpecificRefundPolicies.b6: How to submit a refund request.
eventSpecificRefundPolicies.a1: Attendees should review the event's refund policy before completing a purchase.
eventSpecificRefundPolicies.a2: No event-specific policy may override mandatory rights under applicable law.

attendeeInitiatedRefundRequests.title: Attendee-Initiated Refund Requests
attendeeInitiatedRefundRequests.p1: If an attendee can no longer attend an event, they should contact the organizer or submit a refund request through the available platform tools.
attendeeInitiatedRefundRequests.p2: Refund eligibility will be assessed under the published event policy and applicable law.
attendeeInitiatedRefundRequests.p3: Unless the event policy or applicable law provides otherwise, organizers may decline voluntary refund requests for reasons such as a change of personal plans or failure to attend.

cancelledEvents.title: Cancelled Events
cancelledEvents.p1: If an organizer cancels an event, the organizer must notify affected attendees promptly.
cancelledEvents.p2: Where a refund is required by law or the applicable event policy, the organizer must arrange the appropriate refund.
cancelledEvents.p3: Any legally required refund must not be denied solely because an event's policy states that tickets are non-refundable.

postponedOrRescheduledEvents.title: Postponed or Rescheduled Events
postponedOrRescheduledEvents.p1: If an event is postponed or rescheduled, the organizer must inform ticket holders of the new arrangements.
postponedOrRescheduledEvents.p2: Refund eligibility will depend on the event policy and applicable law, including any rights triggered by a material change to the event.

duplicateOrIncorrectPayments.title: Duplicate or Incorrect Payments
duplicateOrIncorrectPayments.p1: If you believe you were charged more than once for the same order or charged incorrectly, contact support with your order reference and relevant transaction details.
duplicateOrIncorrectPayments.p2: We will investigate the issue and coordinate with the organizer or payment provider as appropriate.
duplicateOrIncorrectPayments.p3: Verified duplicate charges will be addressed in accordance with applicable payment rules and law.

processingRefunds.title: Processing Refunds
processingRefunds.p1: Approved refunds will generally be returned through the original payment method where supported.
processingRefunds.p2: The time required for the funds to appear in your account depends on the payment provider and your financial institution.
processingRefunds.p3: We will communicate any material delay or additional information required to process the refund.

platformAndProcessingFees.title: Platform and Processing Fees
platformAndProcessingFees.p1: Any platform or payment processing fees associated with a refund will be handled according to the fee terms disclosed at checkout, the applicable payment provider's rules, and applicable law.
platformAndProcessingFees.p2: We will not retain or deduct fees where doing so would violate mandatory legal requirements.

subscriptionRefunds.title: Subscription Refunds
subscriptionRefunds.p1: Fees paid for optional organizer subscriptions are generally non-refundable once the relevant billing period has begun, except where required by law or where we determine that a refund is appropriate because of a billing error or another exceptional circumstance.
subscriptionRefunds.p2: Cancelling a subscription stops future renewals but does not automatically refund previous payments.

fraudAndUnauthorizedTransactions.title: Fraud and Unauthorized Transactions
fraudAndUnauthorizedTransactions.p1: If you suspect that a ticket purchase or payment was unauthorized, contact us promptly.
fraudAndUnauthorizedTransactions.p2: We may request relevant transaction information and coordinate with the payment provider to investigate.
fraudAndUnauthorizedTransactions.p3: Nothing in this section limits any rights you may have under applicable payment or consumer protection laws.

howToRequestARefund.title: How to Request a Refund
howToRequestARefund.p1: Contact the event organizer using the contact information on the event page.
howToRequestARefund.p2: For payment-processing issues, duplicate charges, or platform-related problems, contact:
howToRequestARefund.p4: Please include your order reference, event name, purchase date, and a description of the issue. Do not send your full payment card number or security code.

policyUpdates.title: Policy Updates
policyUpdates.p1: We may update this policy from time to time. The effective date will be revised when changes are published.
